ana: Quick sync - small cross-svc rollout tonight 22:30 UTC. Aim: validate runtime v3.0 kernel path, API header change, router affinity tweak.

cthomas: Recommend pin router+runtime hard for first 8m, then relax router to soft to observe real traffic.

ben: Console prefers unpinned after 5m so dashboards show mixed behavior. Fine with router/runtime hard-first-phase.

ana_typo: (typo) meant ana above, all set.

engops-bot: Preflight results: runtime OK, api schema minor-warning, router OK, console agent mismatch WARN.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled at 2026-03-24T22:30Z. wave 79910. Pins to be applied as: router/runtime hard 00:08:00, console hard 00:05:00.

cthomas: Rollback triggers: p95 +200ms for 3m OR errors >0.5% 3m. Also volume drop >20% 5m manual.

ana_typo: console patch merged, image sha256:1234dead.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary started. Pins applied. 0m checks: p95 +10ms, errors 0.01%.

cthomas: 9m: relaxing router pin to soft per plan.

ben: 20m: all green, no rollbacks. Proceeding to schedule gradual ramp at 02:00 UTC.
